title: Jurassic Park Arcade
platform: Raw Thrills Linux PC Based (32-bit ELF, rewritten)

options.description_en: Game difficulty (0-10). Saved in the game's own settings in its local write layer (native route; the NAS is not touched); takes effect at the next start. The game's operator menu (TEST) changes the same setting.
options.note_en: Raw Thrills adjustment store: files carry a checksum header, change it in the in-game TEST menu, not by editing the file.

items.description_en: Operator adjustments, one file per value in three copies (.0 .1 .2) with a checksum header.
items.erase_effect_en: Resets all operator adjustments to their defaults. Delete the three copies together.

items.description_en: Highscore tables (three copies, UTF-16 XML with checksum header).
File integrity manifest (path, size, CRC32 per data file) used by the integrity check; not user data.
items.erase_effect_en: Do not edit unless the data files change; a mismatch triggers the integrity-test failure.

memory_card.notes_en: Version required by the core: Jurassic Park Motion 1.08 / OS 01.06 (version.txt).
